sections.content_text: Section 51 - Approval of bad debt Expenditure (1) Bad debt expenses shall be allowable in cases other than banks and financial institutions, if— (a) bad debt or part of the bad debt becomes unpaid and appears as written off in the books of account; (b) all reasonable steps have been taken for the recovery of the amount due as bad debt prior to the forfeiture; (c) bad debt or part of the bad debt is treated as income in determining income in any income year. (2) In the case of banks and financial institutions, bad debt expenditure shall be allowable, if— (a) bad debt or part of bad debt is finalized as uncollectible by International Accounting Standards (IAS) and applicable in banks and financial institutions in Bangladesh and shown as written off in books as business; (b) all reasonable steps are taken for the recovery of the amount of bad debt as arrears before written off; (c) bad debt or part of the bad debt is treated as income in determining income in any income year.
